_comment: Hand edits on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Eskilstuna C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py), BUILDOUT O5 batch 1 (2026-10-29). Drafted from OSM only so far; facts from the operator's station page, photos or a walk go here with their source. Level names are placeholders until a plan or signage names them.

sources.note: Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000170).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (BUILDOUT O5 batch 1).
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 16 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000170).

1._source: Trafikverket register (CC0), Bilaga 2A tab 4 row 160; BanInfo BIS 687 (track 1): tracks 1, class mellan = 0.58 m above rail, 326 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey

4._source: Trafikverket register (CC0), Bilaga 2A tab 4 row 161; BanInfo BIS 1208 (track 4): tracks 4, class mellan = 0.58 m above rail, 142 m long; a recorded design class, not a survey
